## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` exits 0 (typecheck + tests + all kits mock)
- [ ] `cd web && npm run build` exits 0 (if dashboard touched)
- [ ] Mock-first: runs with zero credentials; live is a second pass, not the only path
- [ ] Idempotency: re-runs resume, never re-pay (for money-moving calls)
- [ ] Analyst returns judgment + citations only — no amounts/dates/accounts from the model
- [ ] Docs updated: README kit table, `submission/DEMO.md`, counts in SUMMARY/CHALLENGE
- [ ] No secrets committed; recordings/output scanned for tokens
